title: TransferLeader to a learner makes it elect and panics its RaftCore (target not in quorum set)
cause: RaftCore handles RaftMsg::TransferLeader by calling Engine::elect() when self.id == to after checking only vote == from; unlike every other election trigger it does not require the node to be a voter, and Candidate::grant_by panics when the non-voter candidate handles its own SaveVote self-grant.
trigger: Call Raft::transfer_leader(leader_vote, to = a learner holding leader_vote, last_log_id) on the learner (or on every node).
consequence: The learner's RaftCore panics (Fatal::Panicked, node down); when called on every node, the higher-term vote requests also depose the current leader.
premises: A learner receives AppendEntries from the leader and therefore holds the leader's committed vote.
transfer_leader does not validate that `to` is a voter, and the documented usage calls it on every node.
SaveVote completion always delivers the local self VoteResponse before remote responses.
